title: GoodDollar Ecosystem Widget wrapper: user journey (MVP)
source: Notion spec "GoodBounties: Ecosystem widget wrapper" (status Defining)
notes: Frames are composed from instances on the Ecosystem Widget Components page and the Claim / AI Credits component pages, bound to the same tokens. Light and Dark follow the Mode theme. Assumptions: four widgets are pinned to the bottom bar (configurable), the fifth slot is More; the embedded widget's own header is hidden because the wrapper header owns title, network and wallet; the Reown modal is third-party UI and drawn as a placeholder; widget icons are placeholders.

frames.name: 1 · claim (default)
frames.transitions: Tap AI Credits → 4 · Tap More → 6 · Disconnect → 2

frames.name: 8 · widget unavailable on network
frames.transitions: Switch network → 1 · or pick another widget

frames.name: 9 · four widgets · More disabled
frames.transitions: Four or fewer widgets: More is disabled
